caption: The drawing depicts a single glass dessert cup centered on a plain, off-white background. The cup has a wide, shallow bowl with a thick rim and a short stem connecting to a round, fluted base. The glass is depicted using shades of yellow, gold, and brown, giving a translucent effect with highlights and shadows to suggest reflection and refraction typical of glass surfaces. The bowl section of the cup features an embossed, repeating pattern of rounded oval shapes. The stem and base are also highlighted with yellow tones, and the base has radiant, linear grooves extending out from the center. There are no other objects or details present in the drawing besides the glass cup and the artist’s signature in the lower right corner.
title: Compote
